scope: Historical open-source FP8 service baseline; fresh cumulative MXFP6 measurements. All MXFP6 arms retain compilation and decode CUDA Graphs, native expert schedules, TRITON_ATTN, TP2, fixed KV and scheduling limits. Adjacent arms change one optimization; prefill CUDA Graph is a separate step after the base. Two sweeps per server lifecycle; GPU clocks unlocked. FP8 hardware and launch configuration were not inspected. Cross-date FP8 ratios measure deployments, not isolated quantization gains.

fidelity_scope: Frozen 256 teacher-forced queries, 10479 targets, historical BF16 reference; diagnostic max_num_batched_tokens=8192 to hold M32 barrier; throughput uses 2048. Numerical timings are never used for throughput.

gain_calculation.throughput: Arithmetic mean of the two unrounded output_throughput_tokens_per_s measurements at each concurrency
gain_calculation.incremental_pct: 100 * (current arm throughput / preceding arm throughput - 1); base has no preceding MXFP6 arm
gain_calculation.mean: Arithmetic mean of the four concurrency-specific percentages, not percentage change of mean throughput
gain_calculation.rounding: Round to two decimals only when rendering Markdown
gain_calculation.excluded_from_cumulative_table: Pre-fix results and later c16/c24 rollback/confirmation measurements
